youtube_description:
Eden Hazard has given his first interview as a Whites' player to Realmadrid TV. The forward revealed how his presentation was an emotional dream come true and he is now hoping to repay all that support during the upcoming season: "It's a great feeling. This jersey means so much to me. Real Madrid is the best club in the world. It's hard to describe what I'm feeling. Stepping out on to the pitch and seeing all the fans is wonderful".
